interactions.title: Unwinding the seven souls
lines: DM: Thinking back to the information that you deciphered the past— over the course of the afternoon, after having defeated all of Rai's secret traps and hidden protections to hide Apollyon's adamantine dagger, the phylactery that holds his soul.

DM: Seeker was able to discover in Apollyon's notes the names of the 7 victims that were sacrificed to form the structure of the phylactery, to form the cocoon which shelters Apollyon's soul and prevents him from ever dying, recorded in the notes that Apollyon kept about how to become a lich.
DM: And you realized the way, then, to destroy the phylactery, largely deciphered by Seeker from Apollyon's notes, is to free the souls of these 7 trapped people.
DM: The simplest way being to take the dagger to the land of the dead, and somehow unwind the souls, restore them to their memories.
DM: Theoretically, is made easier by some memento, some physical object that ties them to the world to help them—help their souls recall who they once were. And so this is what you've been seeking.

before: DM: Okay. So we begin back in the Temple of the Eight Divines in Drankor as night falls. As the spell, the Heroes' Feast that Riswynn has maintained for the past 24 h fades and the protection of Barazal disappears, you can feel the darkness of the city pressing around you, still held off by the holy force of the human gods, the Eight Divines that have hallowed this ground inside the temple, but the darkness you feel as the sun has now set as well is out there, and as you gather your emergency rations, and you know, water skins, whatever supplies you keep stashed in the portable hole for dinner—
after: DM: Yesterday Wellby scouted the large Temple Administration buildings nearby and found a secret record, a Book of Martyrs of the Radiant Path, the religious order that had been founded to oppose Apollyon's rule in the last days of Drankor. Recorded the names and lives of many who were disappeared by Apollyon, taken for various purposes.

DM: 4 of these names matched the names of people that Apollyon had used to construct his phylactery. 3 humans: Antonius Patrius of Drankor, Floria of Aphasium, Marius of Drankor, and an elf Valanthe of Rostaurë, and these 3 humans, whose lives were recorded in this book of martyrs, were also memorialized in the holy chapel of the Radiant Path, the under chapel of the Father, that God of the Eight Divines to which the Radiant Path was dedicated.

DM: And so you've recovered the death masks of 3 of the 7 souls that you must find, and you are able, as Seeker dozed off in the temple, guarding the dagger, to go and recover a silver pen nib from the elf also recorded in the book of martyrs, who, although not buried in the temple, lived close by.

DM: You are left now with the task of finding some memento in the city of Drankor of the 3 remaining people: Seraphina Appleblossom, a halfling and proprietor of the Laughing Wave, a lively tavern that Wellby was able to see a vision of in his ancestral memories on a side street near the massive Custom House, on the docks of Drankor.

DM: Khemut of Targu, a foreigner, presumably from a strange place based on the name and the location, Targu. More than that is hard to say, but your surmise was that this person may have been a sailor or a traveler.
